about.title: Analysis of transcripts in C3 and C3-C4 Moricandia leaves in different developmental stages
about.description: The C3-C4 phenotype is investigated by transcriptome analysis of different leaf deveopmental stages (from 2mm leaf length to mature) in M. arvensis and M. suffruticosa. For comparison the same leaf stages are also analysed in the C3 relative M. moricandioides.
